title: Combination of machine learning-based bulk and single-cell genomics reveals necroptosis-related molecular subtypes and immunological features in autism spectrum disorder
summary: The article reports necroptosis-associated molecular subgroups and a candidate four-gene signature in ASD; the retrospective result does not establish causal subtypes or clinical benefit. Two GEO datasets and peripheral-blood RT-PCR are reported as validation; the paper notes limited performance/sample evidence and need for larger cohorts.
ai_technology: LASSO, random-forest feature selection and SVM-RFE are used to identify candidate genes and build subgroup/signature analyses.
